Title: DB2
Link: https://docs.solidatus.com/solidatus-6.5/connectors/connector-specific-documentation/solidatus-jdbc-connectors/databasespecific/overview-2
Content: DB2 is part of a set of database products built by IBM. The JDBC connector can connect to a DB2 database to pull structure metadata. To leverage these capabilities, solidatus.jdbc.driver must be set to db2.

Title: Model Structure
Link: https://docs.solidatus.com/solidatus-2026.1/connectors/connector-specific-documentation/solidatus-webfocus/modelstructure
Content: The difference between what makes a hold file a target or intermediate file is its usage outside of the report. Output file formats such as PDFs, CSV, XLSX, DFIX (delimited files) are put into targets. Also, XFOCUS file types are put into targets, as these hold files persist on the WebFOCUS server and can be used by other WebFOCUS reports. The full list of output formats that result in a file in targets can be seen below:

XFOCUS
COMMA
COM
COMT
DFIX
PDF
XLSX

Additionally, WebFOCUS reports have the ability to modify external data sources (like Oracle, DB2, etc.). If a report modifies an external relational data source, it will end up in targets.

Note: If the data source is modified multiple times, the snapshot of the latest modification will end up in targets. The previous modifications will be in 'Intermediates', and the names of the hold files will be suffixed with a version number, such as 'DB2 schema (1)'
